//: Coverage gate for the hand-written sources. It is scoped STRUCTURALLY (everything tsconfig.test.json compiled into .test-build/) rather than by an allow-list of file names, so a new hand-written file is gated automatically instead of silently escaping the gate. The generated protobuf/gRPC-web stubs copied to .test-build/api are excluded: they are machine-generated by the proto-compiler and are not hand-written source.
